title: Topologically equivalent yet radiatively distinct orbits in EMRI system
summary: Multiple potential wells for massive test particles, allowing distinct families of bound orbits to coexist, are a characteristic feature of certain exotic compact objects beyond general relativity. Taking the dyonic black hole as a representative example, we demonstrate that such multi-well geometries generically support multiple coexisting branches of bound orbits, in contrast to the single-branch behavior observed in the Schwarzschild spacetime.
